connector.name: x402-market
connector.registryDescription: Let AI agents pay-per-call for any HTTP API via x402 on Base mainnet. One tool: pay_and_call.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the asaishota account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: MCP_BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Funded buyer wallet private key (0x-prefixed). Required for pay_and_call; read-only tools work without it.

env.name: BASE_RPC_URL
env.description: Base RPC endpoint. Defaults to Base mainnet public RPC; Alchemy/QuickNode recommended for higher rate limits.

env.name: BASE_CHAIN_ID
env.description: 8453 = Base mainnet (default, matches live listings). 84532 = Base Sepolia testnet.

env.name: MCP_MAX_PRICE
env.description: Hard cap on per-call cost (USDC). Refuses to pay above this.
